# Network_Fingerprinting

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The extraction of stable, discriminative signatures from the topology of a network to characterize individual systems or conditions. It bridges TCC and iNEST by providing a reproducible way to identify and compare topology-centric network states.
